Independently enumerated cyclic threegram multisets by weight from all words n=1..14; saturation w=2..4 exactly at n=3w and deficit one at 3w-1.
correctness.rationale: Every cyclic binary word gives a nonzero balanced integer circulation on the order-two de Bruijn digraph, and conversely every balanced circulation with connected positive-edge support admits a directed Euler circuit. Flow balance reduces eight threegram counts to a,b,d,f,h and c=b+f-d>=0, with length n=a+h+3b+d+2f and weight w=b+d+f+h. Partitioning exactly by whether both bridge edges b,d occur, one, or neither (single loops / two-cycle) gives five disjoint geometric generating functions in G(z,u). For fixed w>=2, free 000 loop count a admits every length above minimum; case II b=w,f=0 first appears at n=3w and is the unique profile missing at 3w-1. Geometric summation yields S_w cubic parity formulas. Independent direct word enumeration n<=14 matched predicted composition counts and thresholds w=2,3,4; unweighted n14 total 167. This finite check does not prove the infinite GF.
residual_risks: Noiseless, cyclic, ordered threegram counts only; no noisy channel or alphabet-general claim.

A proper sublanguage forbidding 111 is not unrestricted because 111-containing Eulerian profiles are omitted.
